This notebook accompanies Isaac Daroch's research direction. The new question is not only how an agent represents a changing world: **how does retained experience change what the agent expects of itself, and how does that affect its decisions?**

## The new observatory

[Read the self-model protocol](notes/self-model.qmd) or [open the interactive observatory](https://isaac-daroch.github.io/observatory/). The prototype learns bounded, task-conditioned success estimates and uses a designed decision rule. Memory retention is an adaptive heuristic, not a trained neural controller. The mechanisms, priors and limits are disclosed.
